title: Implement the complete physical Gaussian tensor transform
body:
I connect the retained Gaussian expansion, complete chirp and principal-core compression into a physical source-box transform. The isolated `research/physical-gaussian-tensor/` package includes actual coefficient production, four canonical full-support gathers/scatters, short-field moves, periodic halos, original-axis page reuse, source-core assembly and exact normalization restoration.

Under the stated production and inherited transfer contracts, I derive the `R F_s` error bound with `D=d-1` and `gamma=D(2u+ceilLog2(32p)+1)`. I charge the catalogue, spectators, metadata, numerical children and polynomial setup, retaining the existing `.99827619697` transfer allowance. I state the caller growth laws and leave the selected frontier unchanged.

I check the explicit p48/P80 fixture against separate natural-coordinate staged references: 49 inputs, 64 middle coordinates and 49 outputs, with 4,900 final bits and 12 nonzero restored outputs in each direction. The producer regenerates all 113,537 coefficient cells before the consumers use its authenticated immutable return. I also check altered-axis and half-disk rejection, positive reuse, protected outputs and fixed scratch restoration.

I refined the exact arithmetic after the first hosted run reached its 40-second arithmetic limit. I preserve precision and fixtures while using fixed digits, streamed division, bounded leaf counters, numerical-record loops and physical binary support. I retain the larger-parameter paths and test their fallbacks. `ARITHMETIC.md` gives the proofs, control bounds and ownership checks; `CATALOGUE.md` records the page's provenance.

At `035a6532e525e30962dfdab47d6fa42af3c6fe73`, I passed metadata, the 56-file publication check and source-history validation. I passed all six commands from the official Git-free export and checked unchanged bytes and modes for its 57 files, including the receipt. The stage times were 1.504, 2.834, 22.125, 207.631, 166.407 and 163.268 seconds. The declared command limits total 1,200 seconds, with a 440-second maximum. Export SHA256: `f56805393065b97d281662bfd3c7646fd3e4757a40509ff475c1f0f20872ee36`; receipt SHA256: `940fcedf798a88af1a3ce6457138679dde3a7b996ba6ad80044d2ebbcaf0fa69`. New hosted confirmation remains pending. [Discussion3664](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3664) records the previous failed run, historical receipts, overlap checks and current evidence.

I use the finite witness for staged conformance, outside the production precision, separation and locality domain, with reduced Gaussian halos and retained q2 literal children. Its repeated 7×7 source lengths do not form a pairwise-coprime CRT witness. I leave production-sized execution, inherited universal supplier premises, CRT/integer recovery and independent human or formal-kernel review open.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. I retain the complete source exports and attribution from PR3878/3851/3787/3763/3709/3640, Dugongue's PR3877, the RaD project/hipotures and the nested source notices. The package records predecessor credit and the scope of adjacent contributions.
